dedupe_keys.name: methane losses from different biogas plant technologies

description: Viktoria Wechselberger and colleagues publish primary and secondary observations used to calculate methane-loss emission factors for different biogas technologies. The December 2022 deposit supplies a data CSV, column glossary and R Markdown calculation code, with a combined ZIP download. Version two adds the final publication reference while retaining the first version’s data. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. These inputs can calibrate methane-emission assumptions in biogas and waste-treatment simulations or reproduce the associated factor calculations. The observations concern individual plant sites; their locations, measurement dates, plant sample sizes and uncertainty treatment remain unknown from the public summary. Technology averages should not be assumed to represent every operating plant. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this bundle. The data and R calculations were not downloaded or executed.
